data.fund_type: An Open ended Equity Scheme investing in maximum 30 stocks across market capitalization (i.e. multi cap stocks)
data.investment_objective: The Scheme seeks to generate long-term capital growth by investing in a concentrated portfolio of equity & equity related instruments of up to 30 companies across market capitalization.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related securities, (which are not exceeding 30 companies) 65% - 100% Debt and Money Market instruments 0% - 35% Units issued by REITs & InvITs 0% - 10%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Sanjay Chawla and Mr. Kirtan Mehta
data.exit_load: If units of the Scheme are redeemed or switched out up to 10% of the units (the limit) within 12 months from the date of allotment - Nil, If units of the scheme are redeemed or switched out in excess of the limit within 12 months from the date of allotment - 1% of the applicable NAV. If units of scheme are redeemed or switched out after 12 months from the date of allotment - Nil.
